adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real privacy issue. Looking at the diff in email-manager.ts lines 522-545, the sendAddGuestsEmails function passes calendarEvent directly to AttendeeScheduledEmail and AttendeeAddGuestsEmail without any hideCalendarNotes redaction. Comparing to other email sending functions in the codebase (like sendLocationChangeEmails which also uses formatCalEvent), if the event type has a hideCalendarNotes setting, this new code path would expose notes that should be hidden. The finding correctly identifies that the calendarEvent is passed unsanitized to the email templates, which could leak private notes to attendees when guests are added.
